tools.name: get_prayer_times
tools.description: Azaan (start) times for Fajr, sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha at a point, for one or more days. Uses the country's usual method unless one is given, and the official authority's timetable where we hold it (Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapore, Kazakhstan, Morocco). These are not a mosque's congregat

tools.name: find_mosques_near
tools.description: Mosques near a point, nearest first, with their ids for get_mosque_times. has_source says whether we can read the mosque's own times.

tools.name: get_mosque_times
tools.description: One mosque's congregation (iqamah) and Jumu'ah times as the mosque publishes them, from today on, with the azaan times. status says whether they are fresh, stale (latest we have), queued (not read yet) or none.
